name: com.getexpirytracker/storage-guide
title: Expiry Tracker storage guide
description: How long 100 foods keep in the fridge, freezer and pantry, from official food-safety sources.

tools.name: search_foods
tools.description: Finds foods in the storage guide for a food word or a product name in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese or Arabic (for example 'yoğurt', 'opened milk', 'Kaşar peyniri', 'Hähnchenbrust'). Returns up to 8 foods with their slug, a one-line summary and the page URL. Use the slug with get_storage_guide.

query.description: A food or product name, a few words at most.

language.description: Language of the answer: tr, en, de, es, fr, it, ru, ja or ar. Defaults to the language the food was found in.

tools.name: get_storage_guide
tools.description: Returns how long one food keeps in the fridge, freezer and pantry, for each state the guide lists (unopened, opened, cooked, ...), with the best way to store it, spoilage signs, freezing and thawing, myths, advice for people at higher risk, common questions, sources and the page URL. Pass a slug from search_foods, or a food name.

food.description: A slug from search_foods (for example 'yogurt') or a food name.

language.description: Language of the answer: tr, en, de, es, fr, it, ru, ja or ar. Defaults to the language the food was found in.
